title: 32 MINUTES POWERFUL PSALM 100 MORNING PRAYERS TO COMMAND THE DAY
text: There is a sound in this place this morning that heaven has been waiting for. Before you speak a word, before you frame a sentence, before you even open your mouth to worship, heaven is leaning forward because heaven does not move at the sound of complaint. Heaven moves at the sound of thanksgiving. So, before anything else happens here, before prayer, before prophecy, before declaration, I want you to lift your voice not with sorrow, not with the heaviness of yesterday, but with the fire of a man, of a woman who knows that this day was not an accident. Lift your hands. Somebody shout hallelujah like you mean it, like your life depends on it because it does. Psalm 100:1 and 2 says, "Make a joyful noise unto the Lord all ye lands. Serve the Lord with gladness. Come before his presence with singing." That word come is not a suggestion. It is an invitation into an atmosphere, into a courtroom, into a throne room where the king is already seated, already expecting you, already smiling at your arrival before you even said a word. You did not wake up this morning by your own strength. Something kept your heart beating while you were unconscious. Something held your breath steady while your spirit had gone traveling in the realm of sleep. And now you are back, you are life, you are seated, you are reading, you are hearing, and the least you owe heaven is thanksgiving. I feel something rising in my spirit already. There is a company of people this morning who have been carrying weights that were never assigned to them. There is a company of people who have been fighting battles in the dark, alone, silently, while wearing a smile in the daylight. I say to you by the spirit of the living God this morning, it's not like every other morning. This is a gate morning. This is a threshold morning. Something is going to shift in your account, in your body, in your home, in your spirit before this ministration is over. Somewhere in the house of the Lord this morning, there is a father who has been praying for his children for years and has not seen the manifestation. Somewhere there is a woman who has been believing God for a womb to open. Somewhere there is a young man whose business has been under siege the moment he plants, the wind carries it away. The moment he sows, the fowls of the air descend and eat it up before it germinates. I decree to you now that siege is over, that fowl is falling from the sky this morning in the name of Jesus. Let's go back to the title heaven gate for this hour. Enter his gates with Thanksgiving. Psalm 100:4 says it plainly, "Enter into his gates with Thanksgiving and into his courts with praise. Be thankful unto him and bless his name." Now, listen to me carefully because this is not a shallow scripture for children. This is a strategic key for spiritual warriors. A gate is not a wall. A wall keeps you out. A gate is a controlled entrance. It can be opened and it can be shut. Every realm you desire to walk into the realm of healing, the realm of financial increase, the realm of marital fulfillment, the realm of divine encounter has a gate. And the psalmist under inspiration reveals the master key to every one of those gates, Thanksgiving. Not struggle, not striving, not manipulation, not even primarily petition. Thanksgiving. Because Thanksgiving is the language of a settled heart and heaven responds to a settled heart faster than it responds to a desperate one. Desperation says I don't know if God will do it. Thanksgiving says I already know he has done it. And I am simply announcing it before it fully appears. That is why the enemy fights hardest against your gratitude because he knows once your mouth opens in genuine Thanksgiving, the gate begins to move on its hinges. I want you to say this out loud wherever you are. My gate is opening now. Say it again with fire. My gate is opening now in the name of Jesus. There's something else I see in the spirit. Some of you have been trying to force doors that were never gates for you. You've been pushing against walls, wondering why nothing moves, not realizing that your assignment was never in that direction. Some of you have been knocking on the wrong door for 5 years, 7 years, 10 years. This morning, the spirit of God is realigning your sense of direction. He's saying, "Turn. That is not your gate. Come this way." Habakkuk 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at [music] the end it shall speak and not lie." Though it tarry, wait for it because it will surely come. It will not tarry. Your appointed time did not cancel. It only relocated your entrance point. Let the fire fall now. Let the fire fall on every dead altar in the life of everyone reading or hearing this word. I decree every gate assigned to your breakthrough that has been padlocked by ancestral agreement be blasted open now by the thunder of the Holy Ghost. Every gate that men have shut against you out of envy, out of witchcraft, out of family conspiracy, I speak to you as one having authority in Christ, open now. Shakaraba shalam kadosh el rabani koshe. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost move through this atmosphere right now. Somebody said, "Why does this man keep talking about gates?" Because Psalm 24:7-9 says, "Lift up your heads, oh ye gates, and be ye lifted up, ye everlasting doors, and the King of glory shall come in." Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle. Do you see it? The gates do not open because you are strong. They open because the King of glory is coming in and where the King goes, the gates must respond. Your job is not to break the gate by your own strength. Your job is to carry his presence so thick, so heavy, so undeniable that the gate has no choice but to recognize royalty and yield. That is why worship comes before warfare in this house. That is why Thanksgiving comes before petition in this house. You do not barge into a king's courtroom with complaints. You come in with singing. You come in with the fragrance of gratitude and then, once you are seated in his court, once the atmosphere has shifted, then you open your mouth and you begin to decree things and heaven backs it because you have honored the process. I sense that someone reading this has been trying to pray warfare prayers with a complaining heart and wondering why the enemy is laughing at your prayers instead of fleeing. Listen to me, the devil is not moved by the volume of your voice. He's moved by the authority behind your voice and authority flows from a heart that has settled its account with gratitude. So, this morning, before we go to war, we are going to spend real time simply thanking God not for what we want him to do but for who he already is and what he has already done. Thank you, Lord, for the breath in my lungs this morning. Thank you for sparing my life through the night season. Thank you for every trap that was set against me that I never even saw that you dismantled before I woke up. Thank you, Father, for the members of my body that are functioning correctly right now without me even instructing them to. My heart is beating. Thank you, Jesus. My lungs are exchanging air. Thank you, Jesus. My mind is coherent. Thank you, Jesus. I did not do this. You did this. And so, Lord, I bring you the sacrifice of Thanksgiving this morning. Not because everything is perfect, but because you are worthy regardless. Now, hear the declaration rising from my spirit. I declare that this day dominion is restored to the sons and daughters of the kingdom. Genesis 1:28 says, "And God blessed them, and God said unto them, be fruitful and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it, and have dominion." Dominion was the original assignment of man before sin, before fall, before every distortion the enemy introduced. You were not created to beg the earth for permission to live well. You were created to subdue, to have dominion, to rule as a representative of heaven's government on the soil where you are planted. Somewhere along the way, through generational agreement, through fear, through wrong theology, through trauma, many believers have surrendered dominion and adopted survival instead. This morning, we are taking back dominion. I decree over your finances, you will dominate today, not be dominated by lack. I decree over your health, you will dominate disease today. Disease will not dominate your body. I decree over your family, you will dominate confusion today. Confusion will not dominate your household. I decree over your mind, you will dominate anxiety today. Anxiety will not sit on the throne of your thoughts anymore. Rise up, child of the kingdom, rise up and dominate. Let's move deeper because heaven wants to deal with destiny this morning, not surface issues. Jeremiah 29:11 declares, "For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, sayeth the Lord, thoughts of peace and not of evil to give you an expected end." That word expected end in some translations reads as a future and a hope. God already has a blueprint for your life that was designed before the foundation of the world. And every attack you have faced, every delay, every diversion has been an attempt by the kingdom of darkness to hijack that blueprint and replace it with a counterfeit script. There is a young person reading this whose destiny was mapped out for greatness, but somewhere along the way an evil hand tried to switch the file. I speak to every switched file, every altered destiny document in the spirit realm, be restored to original settings in the name of Jesus. Every name that was changed by witchcraft, every identity that was hijacked in the dream realm, every calling that was buried under a strange tree, under a strange river, under a strange altar in the village, I command exhumation now. Come out of that grave, destiny, come out in the mighty name of Jesus. There's a fire falling on generational patterns this morning. Some of you keep repeating the exact same failure your father repeated, the exact same disappointment your mother carried, and you have wondered, is this just my portion? No. Galatians 3:13 says, "Christ hath redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us, for it is written, cursed is everyone that hangeth on a tree." Whatever curse was legally established against your bloodline through covenant, through idolatry, through spoken word, through evil altar, Christ already paid the price to nullify it. The redemption is finished. [music] Our job now is to enforce what has already been settled in the courts of heaven. Say this with your whole chest. I am not a repetition. I am a new beginning. Say it again. I am not a repetition. I am a new beginning. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come against every generational curse operating in the bloodline of everyone connected to this administration. We speak to the curse of premature death be broken now. We speak to the curse of perpetual poverty be broken now. We speak to the curse of marital delay be broken now. We speak to the curse of barrenness physical and spiritual be broken now. We speak to the curse of madness, confusion, and mental torment be broken now. By the blood of Jesus Christ, by the authority of the finished work of the cross, we cancel every legal ground the enemy has used to hold your bloodline captive. I feel the spirit shifting the atmosphere toward family and household. Somebody's home has been a battlefield instead of a heaven. Joshua 24:15 says, "And if it seem evil unto you to serve the Lord, choose you this day whom you will serve. But as for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." There is a declaration embedded in that verse, "As for me and my house." >> [music] >> Joshua did not wait for his household to agree before he made the declaration. He spoke for his house by faith, and his faith became the covering for those under his roof. I speak now over your household, every altar of division erected against your family by witchcraft, by envious relatives, by evil covenant be pulled down now. Every spirit of quarrel assigned to sit at the dinner table of your home be evicted now. I decree peace over your household like a river in the name of Jesus. I decree that your children shall not be scattered, that your marriage shall not be a casualty, that your home shall become a sanctuary of God's presence rather than a courtroom of conflict. Let the fire fall on marriages this morning. There is someone whose marriage has been under demonic assignment, sudden misunderstanding, sudden coldness, unexplainable distance between two people who used to be inseparable. I speak to every spirit of the strange woman and the strange man assigned to break covenant homes be exposed and be disgraced now in the name of Jesus. I speak to every spirit of Malachi's divorce, spirit haunting marriages in this generation. Malachi 2:16 says, "For the Lord, the God of Israel, sayeth that he hated putting away. For one covered violence with his garment, sayeth the Lord of hosts." God is not silent about the sacredness of covenant. He's jealous over your marriage. He's fighting for your home even now. I decree restoration of communication in marriages that have gone cold. I decree romance returning to marriages that have grown mechanical. I decree that every trust that was broken shall be rebuilt brick by brick by the hand of the Holy Spirit. For those still waiting to be married, still praying, still believing, I decree that your Boaz is being positioned, your Ruth is being prepared, and the appointed season of Genesis 24 where Isaac met Rebekah at the well by divine arrangement shall replay itself in your story. Genesis 24:21 tells us Abraham's servant wondered whether the Lord had prospered his journey, and the answer came swiftly, undeniably. I decree that your journey toward covenant love is being prospered right now. Let's move into finances because heaven wants to open gates over money this morning. Malachi 3:10 says, "Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the Lord of hosts. If I will not open you the windows of heaven and [music] pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it. That word windows in the Hebrew carries the idea of floodgates, sluice gates. Something that when open cannot be contained by ordinary human capacity to receive. I decree over every closed financial gate this morning be opened by fire. Every contract that has been delayed unnecessarily be released now. Every payment that has been held back by manipulation, by sabotage, by administrative wickedness be processed and be paid now in the name of Jesus. Every business that has been struggling under an assignment of stagnation receive divine acceleration now. Deuteronomy 8:18 says, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth." I decree that ideas long overdue are downloading into your spirit right now, strategies, connections, divine ideas that will position you for wealth you have not yet imagined. For every one of you trapped under a spirit of financial recycling, where money comes in and immediately leaves through emergencies, breakdowns, unplanned expenses, I speak to that leaking pipe in your finances. Be sealed now in the name of Jesus. No more holes in your pocket. No more Egyptian moth eating your treasure while you sleep. Haggai 1:6 describes it so vividly, "Ye have sown much and bring in little. Ye eat, but ye have not enough. Ye drink, but ye are not filled with drink. Ye clothe you, but there is none warm. And he that earneth wages earneth wages to put it into a bag with holes." I decree that bag with holes is repaired today in the name of Jesus. Kashira baludushikara ba, fire of God consuming every leaking altar over finances now. Let me shift the atmosphere toward health because there is healing power flowing through this administration this morning. Isaiah 53:5 declares, but he was wounded for our transgressions. He was bruised for our iniquities. The chastisement of our peace was upon him and with his stripes we are healed. Notice the tense, not we will be healed, but we are healed. That healing is already a finished legal transaction in the spirit realm. Our responsibility is to appropriate it by faith, to stand on it, to refuse to negotiate with symptoms that contradict a covenant already sealed by blood. I speak to every strange sickness in the body of everyone connected to this word. Every fever, every unexplained pain, every diagnosis that has confused the doctors, every ailment planted through witchcraft, through poison in food, through evil handshake, through covenant cause, I command it to go now. In the name of Jesus. I speak healing over blood conditions, be normalized now. I speak healing over the heart, the kidneys, the liver, the lungs, every internal organ under silent attack, receive the touch of the master's hand now. For every woman battling issues of the womb, I decree the same power that dried up the issue of blood for the woman in Mark chapter 5 verse 25 to 29 is touching you now. Go and be whole. There is a fire falling on mental and emotional health too because deliverance is not only physical. For everyone carrying invisible battles, depression, suicidal thoughts, unexplainable heaviness. I speak to that spirit of heaviness right now. Isaiah 61:3 says, "God gives the oil of joy for mourning, the garment of praise for the spirit of heaviness." I decree that garment settling on you now. You are not weak for struggling. You are being delivered right now. Lift your head. Heaven has not forgotten you. Somebody needs deliverance from addiction this morning. Substances, habits, patterns that have held you hostage in shame. I speak to every chain of addiction break now in the name of Jesus. You are not defined by your relapses. Today is a new gate. Walk through it. Let the spirit of God move now into the realm of covenants and altars because many battles are not natural, they are covenantal. Some of you have unknowingly been tied to evil covenants made by ancestors before you were born, covenants with rivers, with shrines, with secret societies, with false gods disguised as tradition. Those covenants, though made without your consent, have been given legal ground to spiritual attacks in your life. This morning, we break every one of them. I speak to every covenant made on my behalf or on behalf of everyone connected to this word with any river, any tree, any shrine, any ancestral spirit be terminated now by the blood of Jesus. Colossians 2:14 says, "Christ has blotted out the handwriting of that was against us, which was contrary to us, and took it out of the way, nailing it to his cross." Every handwriting of demonic ordinance signed against your life before you were even born, I declare it nailed to the cross and rendered null and void now in the name of Jesus. Every evil altar where sacrifices have been made against your destiny, be scattered [music] by fire now. Every mark placed on you in the dream realm be erased by the blood of Jesus now. Every satanic priest assigned to monitor your progress be blinded and confused now in the name of Jesus. Numbers 23:23 declares, "Surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel." I decree that same shield over you. Surely there is no enchantment that shall prosper against you in the name of Jesus. Baraka Shiloh Ma, Rashi Bakolam. Let every evil altar catch fire now in the name of Jesus. I feel a strong sense that heaven wants to talk about angelic assistance this morning. Psalm 34:7 says, "The angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and delivereth them." You are not walking alone. There is an invisible company assigned to your case file, and this morning I release fresh mobilization of angelic assistance over your life. Hebrews 1:14 calls angels ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. I decree that angels have been dispatched right now to fight battles you don't even know exist, to close doors that would have led you into destruction, to open doors that will lead you into destiny. I decree angelic escort over your travels this week. I decree angelic protection over your children as they step outside today. I decree angelic intervention in every legal case, every negotiation, every meeting scheduled for you this week. Heaven's representatives are already seated at that table before you even arrive. There's a fire that wants to fall specifically against witchcraft assignments because some of what people call bad luck is actually organized spiritual warfare from familiar spirits, from covens, from ancestral practitioners still operating against bloodlines. Exodus 22:18 speaks plainly about the seriousness with which heaven views witchcraft. I speak to every witchcraft altar raised against the people connected to this administration this morning, CATCH FIRE NOW. Every witch, every wizard, every marine spirit, every familiar spirit assigned to monitor and attack your life, receive the backfire of heaven now in the name of Jesus. I decree that every arrow shot against you in the night, physical arrows, spiritual arrows, arrows of sudden misfortune return to the sender now in the name of Jesus. Psalm 91:5-6 says, "Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night, nor for the arrow that flieth by day, nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness, nor for the destruction that wasted at noonday." I decree that covering over you now, no terror by night, no arrow by day, no pestilence in darkness, no destruction at noon shall come near you or your household in the name of Jesus. There's something rising about time and virtue restoration because many of you feel like the enemy has stolen years from you, years you cannot get back, opportunities that passed you by while you were fighting battles that were not even yours to fight. >> [music] >> I decree by the God who restored to Job double what he lost in Job chapter 42:10 that this year, this season becomes a season of double restoration for every year the enemy stole. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust has eaten." I release that restoration now in the name of Jesus, every year lost to sickness be restored. Every year lost to depression be restored. Every year lost to wrong relationships, wrong locations, wrong decisions influenced by manipulation, be restored in the name of Jesus. I also [music] decree restoration of stolen strength, stolen virtue, stolen anointing. Some of you have felt drained as though something has been siphoning your energy, your zeal, your passion for God and for life. I speak to every energy-draining spirit, every vampiric assignment operating against your vitality, be disconnected now in the name of Jesus. Receive fresh virtue, fresh fire, fresh strength flowing into your spirit right now. Like Isaiah 40:31 declares, "They that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings as eagles. They shall run and not be weary, and they shall walk and not faint." Let me pause here and let a word of knowledge flow because the spirit is highlighting specific situations. There is someone who has an interview or an important meeting coming up this week and fear has been trying to convince you that you will fail. I decree you will not fail. Favor is already seated in that room waiting for you. There is someone dealing with a legal matter, a court case, a property dispute. I decree the judgment is turning in your favor even now in the name of Jesus. There is a woman who has miscarried before and is afraid to try again. The spirit says, "This time the fruit shall be established. Fear not." There is a young man who has been rejected by many opportunities and has started to believe something is wrong with him. The spirit says, "It was never you, it was timing and your timing has changed." There is someone whose parent is sick right now and you have been praying quietly, afraid to hope too loudly. The spirit says, "Do not stop praying. The report is changing." There is someone reading this in a foreign country, isolated, homesick, wondering if the relocation was even worth it. The spirit says, "The papers you have been waiting for are being processed now. Breakthrough is closer than it has ever been." Let's rise again into declaration because this is not a morning session, this is a dominating session. Romans 8:37 says, "Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us. Not barely surviving, conquerors, more than conquerors." That means before the battle even fully manifests, the victory has already been recorded in your favor. You are not fighting for victory, you are fighting from victory. I decree today over your assignment, you will not just survive today, you will dominate today. You will dominate every meeting, every conversation, every negotiation, every temptation, every distraction. The spirit of excellence shall rest upon your work today. The favor of God shall go before you into every room you enter today. Every gate that was designed to stop you shall instead salute you today because they will recognize the king you carry. Somebody say it with fire, I dominate today. Say it louder, I dominate today in the name of Jesus. Let's bring more fire to bear on divine preservation because it is one thing to receive breakthrough and another thing to be preserved in it. Many people have received blessing only to lose it because they were not covered by preservation prayer. Psalm 121:7-8 says, "The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil. He shall preserve thy soul. The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth and even forevermore." I decree preservation over your breakthrough. No one will hijack what God is releasing to you this season. I decree [music] preservation over your health. The enemy will not attack you the moment you receive testimony. I decree preservation over your family. No substitution, no counterfeit blessing will slip into your household disguised as good news. I feel the weight of the spirit shifting toward a corporate declaration now. Let every voice reading or hearing this word rise together in agreement. Say after me, from your spirit, not just your lips, "I am a covenant child of the most high God. I enter his gates with thanksgiving, not with complaint. I enter his courts with praise, not with fear. Every gate assigned to my breakthrough is opening now. Every curse assigned to my bloodline is broken now. Every covenant made against my consent is nullified now. My destiny file is restored to its original divine blueprint. My marriage, my family, my finances, my health, my mind are all under the covering of the blood of Jesus. I dominate today. I do not merely survive today. Angels are mobilized on my behalf today. Witchcraft assignments against me are scattered today. Every stolen year, every stolen virtue, every stolen strength is restored to me today. I am preserved. I am protected. I am prosperous in the name of Jesus. And every gate that lifts up its head against me shall bow because the king of glory lives in me. Let the fire fall again, shabakorele, tashi rabakou, fire of the Holy Ghost. Seal every declaration spoken this morning. There's one more thing heaven wants to establish before we close, and it concerns the posture we carry after this ministration ends. Colossians 3:15 and 16 admonishes us to let the peace of God rule in our hearts and to let the word of Christ dwell in us richly. This is not a one-time emotional encounter meant to fade by afternoon. This is meant to become the atmosphere you carry into your workplace, your kitchen, your marketplace, your classroom. Thanksgiving is not a season, it is a lifestyle. Dominion is not an event, it is an identity. So, as you [music] go from this place today, do not go the same way you came. Go with the fire still burning. Go with the gate still opening. Go with the awareness that you carry the king of glory inside of you, and every gate you approach today, every door in every office, every threshold in every relationship, every entrance into every opportunity must recognize the royalty walking through it. I speak final impartation over you now. Receive grace to sustain what has been released this morning. Receive discernment to walk in the wisdom that accompanies breakthrough, so that what is restored will not be lost again to the same old patterns. Receive boldness to declare the word of God over your circumstances throughout this day, not just during ministration time, but at your desk, in your car, in your kitchen, whispering it under your breath if you must, but never letting the fire go cold. Numbers 6:24 to 26 says, "The Lord bless thee and keep thee. The Lord make his face shine upon thee and be gracious unto thee. The Lord lift up his countenance upon thee and give thee peace. I release that blessing over you now in the fullness of its ancient power. Go in peace, go in fire, go in dominion, go in thanksgiving. The gates are open. Walk through them in the mighty, matchless, unrivaled name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. We have prayed, we have declared, we have decreed, and so it is established, and so it shall be forever and ever. Amen and amen and amen.
